page.layout: One column of running text, set in full lines. Page number 445 at the top right. No running head. Catchword "fes" at the lower right, below the last line. No notes in the margins.

main_text.p: Patriarcha Constitinopolitanus, Gregorius Palama Thessalonicensis, Arsenius Cyzicenus, Macarius Philadelphiensis, Iacobus Chalcedonensis, Metrophanes Melenicen. sis, Methodius Pontoëracleensis, Georgius Pegarum, & Parij, Dionysius Berrhoensis, Nipho Trapezuntius, Germanus Traianopolitanus, Esaias Selybriensis, Gabriel Apri, Callinicus Amastridis, Daniel Æni, Eusebius Sugdaiæ, Theodorus Bryseos, Iacobus Madytorum, Neophytus Byziæ, Ioannicius Garellæ, Euthymius Mediæ, Iosephus Tenedi, Theodosius Sozopolis, Theoleptus Metropolita Didymotechi, Tum præterea Adrianopolitanus, & Chrysopolitanus, Amasiensis, Examilij. Episcopi, Heracleæ, Panis, Chariupolis, Pamphyli, Athyræ, Campaniæ, Sardium, Traianopolis, Eleutheropolis: nec non alij Ecclesiæ Constantinopolitanæ proceres, Chartophylax magnæ Ecclesiæ, & Philosophorum Hypatus Ambaris, Magnus Sceuophylax Euthymius Apocaucus, Sacellarius magnæ Ecclesiæ Michaël Cabasila, Magnæ Ecclesiæ Referendarius Manuel Siluefter, Magnæ Ecclesiæ a supplicationibus Theodorus Perdicca, Sceuophylax Imperatorij Cleri Georgius Perdicca, Magnæ Ecclesiæ a Sacra Constitutione Michaël Maniaces, Præ-

page.notes: The first word reads "Constitinopolitanus" in the scan; transcribed as printed. The page ends mid-word at "Præ-" and the catchword "fes" completes it. The page number 445 is printed at the top right. The small dark mark at the bottom centre is a stain or fold, not text, and is left out.
